acceptanceCriteria: Either the direct caller outranks unrelated feature rows at limit 10 on this case, or the output explains why it was omitted.
The case is retained as a regression fixture or frozen evaluation item.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the first complete Beamfall daily-path run (Beamfall scratch clone, change LCRES-15, BASE 0d7796be23efe4e2579408a5516b8aeff1a23008, bind 86fde0eb21d2e0fc41bfc06a4c06c9c3aef63e59; evidence retained in the session scratchpad beamfall-evidence/). `corvint impact internal/plugin/trust.go internal/integrationhost/model_loader.go --limit 10` found both same-package tests and the right go test commands, but the cross-package caller internal/app/skipdetect_jobs.go was among 119 omitted results, while two unrelated features (identify-scrape, library-health) ranked at 800 inside the limit.
title: impact: Beamfall path impact omits the cross-package caller and ranks unrelated features at 800
